description.en-US: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects, volume III (1866-72): the introduction and eleven sermons preached in the Pro-Cathedral on the temporal power of the Pope, Rome and the Revolution, Christ and Antichrist, the Syllabus, the Vatican Council, the pontificate of Pius IX, the divine commonwealth and the triumph of the Church.
description.pt-BR: Sermões sobre Assuntos Eclesiásticos, volume III (1866-72): a introdução e onze sermões pregados na Pró-Catedral sobre o poder temporal do Papa, Roma e a Revolução, Cristo e o Anticristo, o Syllabus, o Concílio Vaticano, o pontificado de Pío IX, a república divina e o triunfo da Igreja.

en-US.editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns, Oates and Co., 1873)

sources.edition: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects (vol. 3) (London: Burns, Oates and Co., 1873), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The sermons and the introduction; the contents, the errata and the index are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning died in 1892 and the edition is of 1873, so the text is public domain.
